description: Create a ServeReel reel from a photo on the connected account. Requires a connected ServeReel account (one-click sign-in).

breakout_subject.description: For the breakout style only: what comes out of the phone screen, for example 'the burger' or 'the dog'.

captions.description: Up to 5 short caption lines shown on the reel.

end_card.description: Add the business end card at the end of the reel.

footage_id.description: A footage ID already in the user's ServeReel library.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying a request so the reel is only created once.

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 data (JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 20MB). Provide image_base64, image_url, or footage_id.

image_url.description: A public http or https link to the photo.

instructions.description: Any extra direction for the reel, in plain words.

qr.description: Add the business QR code badge to the reel.

template.description: Reel style. showcase: product or place showcase. bts: behind the scenes. promo: promotional. breakout: Screen Breakout, the subject comes out of a phone screen (needs the breakout_subject field).

vo_script.description: Exact words for the voiceover. Leave empty to have them written for you.

voiceover.description: Add a spoken voiceover. Default true.

name: create_reel
